items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: he gave me an orchestra. And he told me never to play French music, and to learn the Italian overtures, which I very carefully did learn

ctx.x: Well then I was music director at the network. I became music director, so I became the head psychiatrist for an institution of 185 problem children, between my organist who played the soap operas— And when I started we still had the symphony of course, with Mr. Toscanini.
